items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: Leonard told Buddy, he said, Buddy, I told you the dance was off.

ctx.x: We sat on the top of the car when someone over on the other side saw when the car went down. So they sent a big heavy truck, Landon's Frederick, the man we were playing for. He sent a truck out there. And I think three or four white boys came out on that truck. And saved us, you might as well put it to that. They did save us because we were marooned there, we couldn't move. So that big heavy truck, the current couldn't push it as they bought an ordinary automobile. So they picked us up.
